floorPlans.note: Totals include terraces and follow the May 2023 marketing drawings. Confirm current dimensions and plans for the specific residence.

review.gallery: August 2026 construction photo from OMNIYAT’s VELA update. The four furnished photos show the VELA show residence, announced on 2 November 2026 at https://omniyat.com/news/vela-show-residence-unveiled-at-marasi-bay. Five other gallery images are original brochure renders.
review.location: Official VELA point and page 9 of the original brochure identify the project separately from VELA Viento and The Lana. Madena estimates use its separate nearby reference point.
review.floorPlans: Eight complete typology sheets, dated 17 May 2023, pages 2–9 of the Madena-hosted original. The unit 501 plan and area repeat on page 10 of the dedicated Marina brochure and are shown once. Unit 101 and 1901 have a 0.01 sq ft difference between the sum of the displayed components and the printed total. Display values follow the printed totals.

unavailable: Public full drawings for the four-bedroom Sky Residences, Penthouses and Sky Palace, verified visitor entrance, and finished tower photography. The official portfolio asks for a private meeting to view further floor plans.
